issues.desc: CHK-002 bundles 4 distinct verification scenarios (local/off PASS, shadow warning PASS, enforce fake-server receipt PASS, enforce no-server fail-closed) plus the Lattice parallel_report non-authoritative claim into one checklist item. userSees enumerates them clearly so the user-facing transcript is concrete, but completion judgment becomes ambiguous if any one of the four scenarios partial-passes. Consider whether the DEV-phase tests should produce a single summary line the user can quote when saying "好了", or accept the bundle as inherent to the closing-integration nature of the story.

CHK-001 userSees claims E2E smoke shows receiptVerified:true and klass:receipt-backed-l2-plus, but the fake-authority server harness that produces that smoke output is owned by CHK-002. Either restate CHK-001 userSees in terms of an integration test that CHK-001 itself ships (envelope construction + receipt parse against an in-process stub), or explicitly note CHK-002 must land first as a dependency. Otherwise CHK-001 cannot be marked done in isolation and the two items will be double-counted on the same observable.

background.md is terse and uses domain jargon (L2, klass, receipt-backed-l2-plus, shadow warning, producerRunId/verifierRunId) without inline definition. The relatedDocs (authority-client-role / verification-context-pack / lattice-parallel-wave) define these, but background is supposed to be standalone-readable. Add a one-line glossary or explicit doc:anchor pointer (e.g. "definitions: verification-context-pack.md §evidence-envelope") so a fresh reviewer does not need to traverse 3 decisions to parse the insight.
